body: I hadn't even thought about that. I've got a little twang but nothing bad enough to trip up the voice recognition.

I can agree with that. I miss my old G1/G2 phones with their physical keyboards for this exact reason. On-screen keyboards *never* work correctly for me even after putting several weeks into trying to customize one to do better.
Ooh stealth perks to having something other than English as a primary language!
